item_surface.guidance: Preserve original RGBA and artwork. Use broad material roughness and reflection; use restrained or flat relief unless structure evidence exists. Do not invent geometry or assume every item is wood.

block_surface.guidance: Preserve original artwork and alpha. Evidence-supported structural and material regions are permitted within existing height bounds. Do not invent geometry.

annotations.guidance: Broad wood roughness and restrained or flat relief for the icon; preserve original artwork.
Large pale upper interior panel is wood; left and right dark-gray patches are metal fittings. Qualitative observations only.
Placed door half is a detailed PBR visual-review priority. Wood panel and left/right dark-gray metal-fitting observations are qualitative for the assembled door.
